title.en: Deposit into a Fluid lending pool (fToken)

summary.en: The Safe first gives the fToken you pick an allowance of exactly the amount you type, then calls `deposit` on the same fToken. Through Fluid's Liquidity contract, the fToken pulls these tokens from the Safe and mints fToken shares to the Safe. When depositing, the Fluid app asks only for the amount and sets no minimum shares, so the card asks only for the vault and the amount.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 先授權你選的 fToken 剛好你填的金額，再呼叫同一個 fToken 的 `deposit`：fToken 經 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約把這筆代幣從 Safe 拉走，鑄出 fToken 股份給 Safe。Fluid app 存款時只問金額，不設最少股份，所以卡片只問金庫和金額。

intro.en: The lending pools of Fluid (by the Instadapp team): deposit USDC or USDT to get fTokens. The assets are held together in Fluid's Liquidity contract and lent to Fluid's borrowing vaults.
intro.zh-TW: Fluid（Instadapp 團隊）的借貸池：存入 USDC 或 USDT 換 fToken，資產集中放在 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約，借給 Fluid 的借款 vault。

text.en: The audits page of Fluid's docs lists a MixBytes audit of the Liquidity contract and an update audit by StateMind, plus audits of Fluid by StateMind and PeckShield. The AI found no separate audit report that covers only the EVM fToken contract and names its version. Also, the Resolv (USR) incident of 2026-03 left Fluid's borrowing vaults with about 21 million US dollars of bad debt. Fluid's post-mortem says Resolv, the governance treasury and the team covered it, and user deposits lost nothing. This incident is not on DefiLlama's hack list.
text.zh-TW: Fluid 文件的稽核頁列出 Liquidity 合約的 MixBytes 稽核和 StateMind 的更新稽核，另有 StateMind 與 PeckShield 的 Fluid 稽核。AI 沒有找到只針對 EVM fToken 合約、標明版本的獨立稽核報告。另外，2026-03 的 Resolv（USR）事件讓 Fluid 借款 vault 產生約 2,100 萬美元壞帳；Fluid 的事後報告說由 Resolv、治理金庫和團隊補上，使用者存款沒有損失。這件事不在 DefiLlama 的駭客列表。

text.en: On 2026-05-27 the proposer and approver private keys of Fluid's reward distribution system were stolen, and the attacker paid out rewards of about 125,000 FLUID and 52,000 GHO, about 215,000 US dollars. Fluid disclosed it only on 2026-05-31, saying the lending pools, the vaults and user deposits were not affected. The AI found no formal post-mortem.
text.zh-TW: 2026-05-27 Fluid 獎勵發放系統的提案與核准私鑰被盜，攻擊者發出約 125,000 FLUID 和 52,000 GHO 的獎勵，約 21.5 萬美元；Fluid 在 2026-05-31 才公開，說借貸池、vault 和使用者存款沒有受影響。AI 沒找到正式事後報告。

text.en: The deposited tokens are held in Fluid's Liquidity contract, an upgradeable InfiniteProxy. At every signing the program checks that it and its 4 implementations are unchanged. After an upgrade, verify gives MISMATCH until a new code pin is merged. The program does not see an implementation that only adds brand-new functions; Fluid did that once, at block 24,649,359.
text.zh-TW: 存進去的代幣放在 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約，它是可升級的 InfiniteProxy。程式每次簽名都確認它和它的 4 個實作沒變，升級後 verify 判 MISMATCH，直到新的 code pin 合併；只新增全新函式的實作看不到，Fluid 在區塊 24,649,359 做過一次。

recommendation.en: If verify gives MISMATCH, do not sign. After Fluid upgrades, wait until the new code pin is merged before you deposit.
recommendation.zh-TW: verify 判 MISMATCH 就不要簽；Fluid 升級後，等新的 code pin 合併再存。

text.en: `deposit` sets no minimum shares. In the past transactions studied, every direct deposit into an fToken, by Safes and EOAs alike, used this two-argument version; none called the version with `minAmountOut_`. By the contract's design, the fToken's exchange price comes from Liquidity's interest accrual and only rises, so it is hard to push the price up at the moment you deposit.
text.zh-TW: `deposit` 不設最少股份。研究過的過去交易裡，直接存進 fToken 的 Safe 和 EOA 都用這個兩參數版本，沒有一筆呼叫帶 `minAmountOut_` 的版本。依合約設計，fToken 的換算價格來自 Liquidity 的利率累計，只升不降，存款當下很難被抬價。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. If it matters to you, after verify check the number of shares the Safe actually received.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；在乎的話，verify 之後看 Safe 實際收到的股份數。

1.approve.spender.en: The contract allowed to pull tokens from the Safe, fixed as the fToken you pick. In call 2 the fToken pulls this money with `transferFrom` through Liquidity's callback.
1.approve.spender.zh-TW: 被授權從 Safe 拉代幣的合約，固定是你選的 fToken。呼叫 2 裡 fToken 透過 Liquidity 的回呼用 `transferFrom` 拉走這筆錢。

1.approve.value.en: The allowance's cap, equal to the deposit amount. Call 2 uses all of it, and the allowance is back to 0 after the transaction.
1.approve.value.zh-TW: 授權的上限，等於存款金額。呼叫 2 會整筆用掉，交易後授權回到 0。

2.deposit.assets.en: The number of tokens deposited into the fToken, equal to the deposit amount. The fToken computes the shares to mint from the exchange price at that moment.
2.deposit.assets.zh-TW: 存進 fToken 的代幣數量，等於存款金額。fToken 依當下換算價格算出要鑄的股份。

2.deposit.receiver.en: The address that receives the fToken shares, fixed as the Safe.
2.deposit.receiver.zh-TW: 收 fToken 股份的地址，固定是 Safe。

role.en: Fluid's lending pool factory, which computes each asset's official fToken address with `computeToken`
role.zh-TW: Fluid 的借貸池工廠，用 `computeToken` 算出每個資產的官方 fToken 地址

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract name FluidLendingFactory. Its creation transaction was sent by 0x0Ed35B1609Ec45c7079E80d11149a52717e4859A through the public CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C; the same account deployed Liquidity
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約名 FluidLendingFactory，建立交易由 0x0Ed35B1609Ec45c7079E80d11149a52717e4859A 經公用 CREATE2 部署器 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C 送出；同一個帳號也部署了 Liquidity

role.en: Fluid's Liquidity contract: the tokens the fTokens receive are actually held here. No call goes to it directly
role.zh-TW: Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約：fToken 收到的代幣實際放在這裡，沒有呼叫直接打到它

text.en: This contract's LogSetImplementation and LogRemoveImplementation events on Etherscan: 4 implementations are still set, last changed at block 25,007,782. Each of the four seeds reaches one of them, and these are the same 4 the program reads
text.zh-TW: Etherscan 上這個合約的 LogSetImplementation、LogRemoveImplementation 事件：目前仍設定的實作有 4 個，最後一次變更在區塊 25,007,782；四個 seed 各接到其中一個，程式讀到的也是這 4 個
